instructions:
1. Sit at the row machine with your chest against the pad and feet on the footrests.
2. Grip the handles with an overhand grip, arms extended forward.
3. Keep your back straight and core braced.
4. Pull the handles toward your torso, driving your elbows back past your sides and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Slowly extend your arms back to the start under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lead with your elbows to engage the back, not the arms.
2. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
3. Keep your torso still; do not swing.
4. Exhale as you pull and inhale as you return.
name: Seated normal grip row machiNe

instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your legs extended and feet together. Loop the band around the soles of your feet and hold a handle in each hand, arms extended forward, palms facing each other.
2. Sit tall with your back straight, chest up, and core braced.
3. Pull the handles toward your torso, keeping your elbows close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
4. Slowly extend your arms back to the start under control.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back straight; do not slouch or round forward.
2. Brace your core to stop your torso from rocking.
3. Use a controlled tempo in both directions.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
name: Seated Resistance band - cable rows

instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight and your back upright.
2. Place both hands flat on the floor about 30 cm behind your hips, fingers pointing back.
3. Keep your arms straight and lean your torso back slightly.
4. Press your chest up and draw your shoulder blades together until you feel a stretch across the front of the shoulders and chest.
5. Hold, then return to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your arms straight and hands firmly planted.
2. Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.
3. Perform on a non-slip surface to prevent your hands sliding.
4. Breathe steadily and ease deeper into the stretch on each exhale.
name: Seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with a backrest, feet flat on the floor. Hold a barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width and rest it on your upper chest.
2. Brace your core and keep your back against the backrest.
3. Press the barbell straight overhead by extending your elbows.
4. Fully extend your arms with the bar over your head.
5. Lower the barbell back to your upper chest under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your wrists straight and stacked over your forearms.
2. Brace your core to protect your lower back.
3. Press the bar in a straight vertical line, keeping it close to your face.
4. Exhale as you press up and inhale as you lower.
name: Seated shoulder press barbell

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
2. Hold the edge of the bench with your left hand for support.
3. Reach your right arm up overhead.
4. Lean your torso to the left until you feel a stretch down the right side of your body.
5. Hold, return to center, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move into the stretch slowly and stay in control.
2. Keep your supporting hand firm on the bench for stability.
3. Lengthen up through the reaching arm rather than collapsing sideways.
4. Breathe steadily and relax deeper on each exhale.
name: Seated side stretch
